categories.name: Gas
categories.desc: Gas stations. Pay at the pump or inside.

categories.name: Groceries
categories.desc: Supermarkets and grocery stores. Walmart, Target and warehouse clubs usually do not count.

categories.name: Dining
categories.desc: Restaurants, fast food, coffee shops, takeout and delivery.

categories.name: Online shopping
categories.desc: Buying from a website or app, not in a store.

categories.name: Warehouse club
categories.desc: Costco, Sam's Club, BJ's. Costco warehouses in the US take Visa only.

categories.name: Walmart or Target
categories.desc: General merchandise stores. Most cards do not count these as grocery stores.

categories.name: Drugstore
categories.desc: Pharmacies and drugstores.

categories.name: Travel
categories.desc: Airfare, hotels, cruises and travel agencies booked directly.

categories.name: Flights
categories.desc: Airline tickets bought from the airline.

categories.name: Hotels
categories.desc: Hotel stays booked with the hotel.

categories.name: Issuer travel portal
categories.desc: Booked through the card issuer's own travel site (Chase Travel, Amex Travel, Capital One Travel, Citi Travel).

categories.name: Transit and rideshare
categories.desc: Trains, buses, rideshare, taxis, parking, tolls.

categories.name: Rental car
categories.desc: Car rentals.

categories.name: Streaming
categories.desc: Streaming subscriptions.

categories.name: Utilities
categories.desc: Electric, gas, water, internet.

categories.name: Cell phone bill
categories.desc: Your wireless bill. Paying it with the right card can also add phone protection.

categories.name: Home improvement
categories.desc: Hardware and home improvement stores.

categories.name: Entertainment
categories.desc: Movies, concerts, tickets, theme parks.

categories.name: Department store
categories.desc: Department stores.

categories.name: Gym and fitness
categories.desc: Gyms and fitness clubs.

categories.name: EV charging
categories.desc: Electric vehicle charging.

categories.name: Rent
categories.desc: Rent payments.

categories.name: Card's own merchant list
categories.desc: A list of merchants specific to one card.

categories.name: Paid with phone wallet
categories.desc: Purchases made with Apple Pay or Google Pay.

categories.name: Everything else
categories.desc: Anything that does not fit a bonus category.
